posts.text: A win for Californians - today, PG&E received its first payment through the Department of Energy's Civil Nuclear Credit Program. ⁠ ⁠ The funding will be used to repay the Department of Water Resources loan that helped enable Diablo Canyon's extended operations through 2030, supporting reliable, affordable, carbon-free electricity as California transitions to a clean energy future. ⁠ ⁠ This partnership demonstrates how state and federal investments can work together to strengthen energy reliability and independence and deliver value for customers.
